related.title: 持續整合與交付管線
related.why: 版本與產物摘要可串接 CI 證據
related.transfer: 版本與產物摘要可串接 CI 證據
related.difference: 可重現要求跨建置位元一致，CI 可只有單次測試
related.differenceEn: Reproduction needs byte equality across builds; CI may test once
practice: 由「重現定義」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「可重現要求跨建置位元一致，CI 可只有單次測試」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From reproduction definition, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Reproduction needs byte equality across builds; CI may test once", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

history.title: 建置輸入契約
history.text: 官方公開資料「可重現建置定義」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「重現定義」及「輸入清單」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference Reproducible-build definitions supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with reproduction definition and input manifests before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
